description: Congress hasn’t passed significant technology regulation since the floppy disc era. In Congress, Scott will pass a comprehensive data privacy law, bring regulations into the 21st century by passing real social media protections, and take his landmark California net neutrality law national to ensure the internet works for everyone, not just big tech. AI is the most transformative technology in human history, and it deserves leadership that matches that moment. Scott will fight for smart governance that keeps America ahead without leaving safety and our workforce behind.
